name: Residence Card for Spouses of Algerian Nationals

requirements.blocker_text: A dedicated residence-card category ('carte de resident') exists for spouses of Algerian nationals, distinct from the general work- or investor-based residence cards.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the spouse-of-Algerian-national residence card with proof of marriage.

sources.title: Openshores (private immigration-guide site) -- confirms existence of a spouse-of-Algerian-national residence card category, without detailed requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Algeria). STATUS: DRAFT -- this is one of the thinnest files in this build: the single source reviewed only confirmed this residence category EXISTS, without documentary requirements, fees, or duration -- a genuine gap, disclosed rather than filled in with assumptions. Algeria's own Ministry of Interior page (interieur.gov.dz), which would likely detail this exact category, returned an SSL/certificate error on every fetch attempt in this build -- worth a dedicated retry. This is a separate route from dz_citizenship_by_marriage.json: this file covers RESIDENCE for a spouse of an Algerian citizen, the other covers the specific path to Algerian CITIZENSHIP via marriage (3 years married + 2 years residence). citizenship_after_months set 36 mirroring that citizenship route's marriage-duration requirement, not independently confirmed as an automatic link between the two.
